Why Retrieval Augmented Generation Works

Retrieval augmented generation improves answer quality by grounding a model's output in retrieved passages rather than its parametric memory.

Grounding and citations

Because every answer cites the chunk it came from, readers can verify the claim. See the grounding docs for details.
